Brunch de Reinas is coming in HOT and the countdown starts now 👑🥂 Four queens, zero mercy, pure fuego from the first sparkle to the last sashay — mimosas flowing, mischief guaranteed. Doors crack open at 9:30AM pero mira, the real magic starts even earlier if you go VIP: Meet the Queens happens 10-11AM before brunch service even hits the table. Then it's showtime 11AM-1PM with the reinas serving looks, lip-syncs, and laughs que no vas a olvidar. Stick around for photos with the queens 1-2PM and let the Day Party carry you home 2-4PM. This is the kind of Friday you tell your friends about on Friday — so reserve your table now, because reinas like these don't wait for stragglers. Mimosas in hand, crown on head, let's go 💃✨

Picture this: disco ball spinning, mimosa in your hand, four queens serving looks so sharp you can feel the heat from your seat 🔥🥂 No melting faces here, mija — just glam, glitter, and pure fuego from doors to last call. The clink of champagne flutes, the gasp of the crowd when the reveal hits, the smell of brunch plates landing table after table — Brunch de Reinas is a whole sensory experience wrapped in feathers and sequins. Doors open 9:30AM, VIP gets up close to Meet the Queens 10-11AM, brunch service rolls 10AM-2PM, and the show takes over 11AM-1PM with energy que no se puede explicar, solo se siente. Snap your photos with the queens after 1-2PM, then let the Day Party keep the vibe alive till 4PM. Come hungry, leave dazzled ✨

Bring your tía, bring your best friend, bring whoever's never seen queens like these before — todos son bienvenidos a esta mesa 💕👑 Brunch de Reinas is for anybody who loves good mimosas, better company, and a show that feels like family by the time it's over. No dress code except maybe some extra sparkle. Come as you are and let the queens do the rest — sit down for brunch, get up close during VIP Meet the Queens, laugh through the show, and snap a photo you'll treasure forever. This is Pasco's Latinx community and beyond, all under one roof, sharing plates and stories and a whole lot of joy. Ven como eres, quédate como familia 🌟 Doors 9:30AM, VIP 10-11AM, brunch service through 2PM, show 11AM-1PM, photos 1-2PM, and a Day Party to close it out 2-4PM. Nobody sits alone at this table.

Brunch service runs 10AM-2PM so you've got plenty of time to eat, sip, and settle in. The main event, the drag show itself, runs 11AM-1PM with four queens bringing serious heat. After the show, Photos with the Queens go from 1-2PM, and the celebration doesn't stop there — a Day Party keeps the mimosas and music going 2-4PM. Tickets range $15-$50 depending on your seat, so pick your package and lock it in before it sells out. Mimosas, brunch, and drag — the whole formula, no notes. Reserve your table now, we'll see you at 9:30 🥂✨
